title: Encrypted Lifecycle StateDeltaV1 (Revision 6 frozen)
description: StateDeltaV1 has exactly {delta_version,delta_id,operation,object_kind,object_id,revision_id,expected_active_revision_id,envelope_ref,assertion_id,evidence_edge_id,evidence_fragment_ref,deletion_command_id,scope_digest,reason_code}. Every absent/inapplicable value is literal JSON null; empty strings are invalid. `delta_id = SHA-256(b"wiki.state-delta.v1\0" || canonical_json(fields except delta_id))` and the supplied ID must match. ADD/MEMORY_REVISION requires non-null object/revision/envelope with expected_active_revision_id null only for the first revision. ADD/ASSERTION requires object/revision/assertion non-null with expected_active_revision_id equal to the memory revision being asserted. ADD/EVIDENCE_EDGE requires object/revision/assertion/edge/evidence-fragment refs non-null. RETRACT requires target identity and expected_active_revision_id non-null with envelope_ref null. TOMBSTONE requires target identity, deletion_command_id, scope_digest, and reason_code non-null with envelope/addition fields null. Unknown operation/object combinations, duplicate target operations, ADD+TOMBSTONE of the same consent-epoch target, missing refs, and cross-workspace refs fail closed.
